response.reason: This mirrors the actual vLLM kernel: computing score = (target - draft) * inv_q without an explicit max(...,0) clamp is safe because over-proposed tokens yield negative scores, which lose to any nonnegative score; only in the degenerate all-over-proposed case could a negative token win, matching the reference's own undefined behavior there. Masking with -inf, per-block argmax with return_indices, cross-block max tracking, and the final clamp are all handled correctly.
